Terrestrial Spiders

Terrestrial tarantulas are spiders that live on the ground, often in burrows or under bark. Usually ambush predators awaiting prey to wander past their lair. There are some beautiful species in this group which are very brightly coloured and make great display animals. Out of the Tarantulas some of terrestrial species are the most handleable although we would recommend keeping handling to a minimum.

Arboreal Spiders

Arboreal tarantulas are tarantulas that have made their home up in the trees. Often being much faster and more nimble which is shown in their hunting style, fast grab and take down. Arboreal tarantulas tend to be more reactive and aggressive by nature. This group also has some extremely beautiful coloured spiders that make incredible display animals.

Invertebrates

To be an invertebrate means to lack a backbone or spinal column. In fact, inverts lack bones altogether. This group is one the oldest on our planet and therefore the most diverse group. They account for 95% of the animal species on earth. This huge array of choice and variety coupled with their alien-like appearance and behaviour is what makes them so addictive to keep.
